releases.name: Roots in the Sky - The Hand of Glory 2
releases.summary:
In an attempt to elude the cult that's been chasing him, former Miami detective Lazarus "Lars" Bundy is in Italy working incognito for a security agency when his client is murdered in cold blood by a sharpshooter. As the blood stain slowly spreads on the victim's clothes, Lars realizes there is only one way to keep his past from catching up with him: solve the case before the police and bring the perpetrator to justice as quickly and silently as possible.

With help from an old ally he thought he'd left behind for good, Lars finds himself swept up in a case far more complex and dangerous than he ever could have imagined, filled with international mystery and mysticism. And all the while, a much more personal danger lurks close at hand, one that Lars is determined to suppress and keep hidden from the world.

releases.name: BOMBER-ANGEL BOMBRIEL -FOREVER THE KINGS-
releases.summary: Bomber Angel Bombriel – FOREVER THE KINGS – is a top-down free-scrolling bomb-placement action/shooter that shares the same lineage as classic masterpieces like RoboWarrior (NES). It’s a fresh new game dressed in pastel, cute visuals—nostalgic in spirit, yet with noticeably improved controls.

releases.name: Neon Highway
releases.summary: A chill synthwave driving game. Cruise glowing wireframe highways beneath an endless neon sunset — unlock routes, build your own soundtrack, and drift through the night. No pressure, no timers to fear: just you, the road, and the music.

releases.name: LoFi Long Distance
releases.summary: If you're looking for a melancholic vibe with some chill tunes, or just want to hangout in the early 2000s, LoFi Long Distance is for you. Get your nostalgia on!

releases.name: Nightlatch
releases.summary: A low-to-mid poly horror escape game across 3 different houses. Find the keys you need room by room, hide from a stalking presence, and uncover the story through scattered notes - each house with 4 difficulty tiers of 10 levels.

releases.name: Idle Fleet
releases.summary: Build your mining fleet in a persistent online universe where every player helps shape the economy. Train 7 skills, automate production with drones, trade on the player-driven market, and forge the legendary Vanguard hull while your fleet keeps working on the server.

releases.name: Find My Frogs: Branches
releases.summary: Find My Frogs: Branches is a cozy hidden object game where you search for frogs and toads in a hand-drawn village nestled high in the branches of an ancient tree. Explore charming corners, discover tiny secrets, and help Uncle Froger find his missing hat.

releases.name: Ghostly Simulator -- Your Neighboring Ghost Story Collection
GHOSTFLIPPERS
releases.summary: Flip haunted houses with your friends… before the ghost flips you. Reach your quota, grow your business, and survive the night.

releases.name: Ether Flow :: Focus, organize, and create.
releases.summary: Ether Flow is a desktop productivity tool that turns your focus time into alchemical resources. Maintain your concentration with real-time distraction detection and pure work tracking. Hatch and nurture a diverse cast of charming homunculus girls as you complete your daily goals!

releases.name: My Beautiful Summer
releases.summary: You’re back home for the summer. Relax, chat with the locals, take on their quests, unravel mysteries and solve puzzles, explore the island, and most importantly, enjoy the sea breeze.
